subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification — Atlas Payments
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Chris Walker <chris.walker@atlaspayments.com>, Priya Shah <priya@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity — quick recap & asks (post-demo)

Hi Chris / Priya —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time and for walking through your integration. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can size dedicated capacity and put together a pricing proposal that maps to your unit economics:

Summary from call:
- Target workload: conversational assistants + reranking for fraud signals (short responses, avg gen length ~120 tokens)
- Expected initial volume: ~2M tokens/day (burst to 5M/day during peak events)
- Desired latency: P95 generation <= 300ms for 1–2 turn interactions
- Preferred model: open Llama-2 family / or 70B-class variant (you mentioned wanting high quality)

Key sizing/pricing inputs we need from you:
1) Confirm monthly token expectation (you mentioned ~60M tokens/month initial?) and peak/day estimate.
2) Preferred GPU family for reserved capacity (H100 vs A100) or open to recommendations based on cost/throughput tradeoffs.
3) Target budget range for dedicated (monthly committed spend) and a target $/1M tokens you want us to aim for.
4) Any SLA/regulatory constraints (data residency, SOC2 evidence) — we can attach relevant docs.

Attached: token_volume_estimate.xlsx (placeholder with the numbers you walked through).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the three items above.
- If fine, we’ll scope two options: small reserved (2x A100 equivalent) and performance reserved (4x H100 equivalent) with expected throughput and unit economics per 1M tokens.
- Technical deep-dive with Marcus (cc'd) to validate latency/throughput on a representative prompt set.

Will prepare a rough cost estimate once you confirm the numbers.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

From: Chris Walker <chris.walker@atlaspayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — quick recap & asks (post-demo)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Volume: our conservative rollout is ~2M tokens/day (~60M/month). If pilot goes well we expect to ramp to ~5M tokens/day (~150M/month) over the next 3–6 months.
2) Budget: for committed infra we were thinking in the $40k–$60k/month range initially (flexible if unit economics look attractive).
3) Unit economics target: we’d like to get to ~$500–$800 per 1M tokens at scale (we know dedicated pricing mixes fixed commit + effective $/token).
4) GPU preference: we prefer H100 family if the perf gains justify the delta vs A100 — latency for scoring/reranking is important.
5) SLA: standard enterprise SLA + SOC2 is sufficient for now.

I attached a short export of our token logs for the last 30 days (see token_volume_estimate.xlsx). Happy to run the technical deep-dive next week.

--
Chris Walker
Head of ML Platforms, Atlas Payments
chris.walker@atlaspayments.com

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — quick recap & asks (post-demo)

Thanks Chris — that’s very helpful. Based on your inputs we’ll propose two committed-capacity options (monthly):

Option A — Cost-conscious (2x A100-equivalent reserved)
- Target monthly commit: ~$32k–$38k/month
- Expected steady throughput: ~200–400 tokens/sec (handles 2M tokens/day comfortably)
- Peak handling: bursts via burst capacity (adds short-lived nodes) to ~1200 tokens/sec
- Effective $/1M tokens estimate at 60M/mo: ~$650–$750

Option B — Performance (4x H100-equivalent reserved)
- Target monthly commit: ~$52k–$60k/month
- Expected steady throughput: ~1200–1800 tokens/sec (handles 5M tokens/day and sustained peaks)
- Better P95 latency profile for large context models
- Effective $/1M tokens estimate at 150M/mo: ~$350–$500

Notes:
- Exact $/1M depends on model choice, average sequence length, and how much caching/prefix reuse we can exploit.
- We recommend Option B if you expect to ramp to 150M/mo within 3–6 months and latency is a hard constraint.

Next steps:
1) Marcus to run a short perf validation (2–3 day run) on your sample prompts to validate throughput and P95 latency. Marcus — can you confirm availability next week?
2) I’ll draft a SOW / pricing sheet and share a DocuSign link for approval (attached initial SOW draft).
3) If this looks good, we’ll loop in procurement and draft the committed contract.

If you want, I can also include a blended option (3x H100 equivalent) that sits between A & B.

Best —
Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — quick recap & asks (post-demo)

Hi team — quick technical note on GPU sizing and perf expectations before the scheduled run: 

- H100 (80GB) is the recommended baseline for 70B-class models with long context (>=16k). For shorter context (<=4k) A100 can still be cost-effective.
- Ballpark throughput:
  * 2x A100-equivalent reserved: ~300–600 tokens/sec depending on batch strategy and KV cache hit rate.
  * 4x H100-equivalent reserved: ~1200–2000 tokens/sec with optimized kernels and batching.
- For your workload (avg 120 tokens/gen, mix of short LLM responses + reranking) we expect Option B to meet P95 < 300ms in most cases.
- Perf validation plan: 48-hour run with a representative prompt set (you provide), we’ll measure sustained throughput, cold-start behavior, and cache hit rates.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
